description:
Create app shopping

Features:
SCREENS & LAYOUTS:                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  1. HOME SCREEN (Tab - index):                                                                                                                                                                                                
  - Top: Search bar with mic icon, notification bell with badge count
  - Location bar showing "Deliver to: John - New York 10001" with dropdown                                                                                                                                                     
  - Hero carousel/banner slider with promotional offers (auto-scroll)                                                                                                                                                          
  - Category row: horizontal scroll with icons (Electronics, Fashion, Grocery, Beauty, Sports, Books, Toys, Home)                                                                                                              
  - "Deal of the Day" section with countdown timer, product cards with original price strikethrough and discount percentage                                                                                                    
  - "Trending Now" horizontal product list with image, title, price, rating stars                                                                                                                                              
  - "Recently Viewed" horizontal scroll                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - "Recommended for You" grid (2 columns) with product cards                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Each product card: image, title (2 lines max), price in bold, original price strikethrough, discount badge, rating (stars + count), "Add to Cart" button                                                                   
  - Bottom: Tab bar with Home, Categories, Cart (with item count badge), Orders, Account icons                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  2. CATEGORIES SCREEN (Tab - explore):                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - Grid layout (2 columns) showing all categories with icon and name                                                                                                                                                          
  - Each category tappable, shows subcategories                                                                                                                                                                                
  - Top picks from each category section                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Filter chips: Sort by price, rating, brand, discount percentage
3. PRODUCT LISTING SCREEN (search results / category products):                                                                                                                                                              
  - Filter bar: Sort (Price Low-High, High-Low, Rating, Newest), Filters button                                                                                                                                                
  - Filter modal: Price range slider, Brand checkboxes, Rating filter, Discount filter, Availability toggle                                                                                                                    
  - Product grid (2 columns) or list view toggle                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Each card: product image, title, price, MRP strikethrough, discount %, rating stars, delivery estimate, "Add to Cart" button                                                                                               
  - Infinite scroll / load more                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                            
  4. PRODUCT DETAIL SCREEN:                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Image carousel with dot indicators (swipeable)          
  - Product title, brand name                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Rating: stars + rating number + review count (tappable to scroll to reviews)                                                                                                                                               
  - Price section: selling price (large, bold), MRP strikethrough, discount percentage in green                                                                                                                                
  - "In Stock" or "Out of Stock" status                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - Delivery: "Free delivery by Wed, 25 Apr" with pin code input                                                                                                                                                               
  - Variant selector: Size buttons / Color circles with labels                                                                                                                                                                 
  - Quantity selector: minus, number, plus                                                                                                                                                                                     
  - "Add to Cart" button (full width, primary color)                                                                                                                                                                           
  - "Buy Now" button (outline)                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - Product highlights: bullet points
- Description: expandable text section                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Specifications: table format (key-value pairs)          
  - Customer reviews section: overall rating, rating breakdown bar chart, individual review cards with user name, date, stars, text, helpful count                                                                             
  - "Similar Products" horizontal scroll at bottom                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  5. CART SCREEN (Tab):                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - If empty: empty cart illustration, "Continue Shopping" button
  - Cart item list: product image, title, variant info (size/color), quantity selector (+/-), price, "Remove" and "Save for Later" buttons                                                                                     
  - Price summary card: subtotal, discount, delivery charge, total                                                                                                                                                             
  - Coupon section: "Apply Coupon" input with "Apply" button, applied coupon with remove option                                                                                                                                
  - "Proceed to Checkout" button (large, primary)                                                                                                                                                                              
  - "Saved for Later" section below with items and "Move to Cart" button                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  6. CHECKOUT SCREEN:                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Step indicator: Address > Payment > Review                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - Delivery address: selected address card with "Change" button, "Add New Address" option                                                                                                                                     
  - Payment method section: UPI, Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, Cash on Delivery options with radio buttons                                                                                                                   
  - Order summary: collapsible item list with quantities and prices                                                                                                                                                            
  - Price breakdown: item total, delivery, discount, total payable
- "Place Order" button                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  7. ORDER SUCCESS SCREEN:                                  
  - Checkmark animation/icon                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - "Order Placed Successfully!"                            
  - Order number                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Estimated delivery date
  - "Track Order" button                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - "Continue Shopping" button                              

  8. ORDERS SCREEN (Tab):                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Toggle tabs: "Active Orders" and "Past Orders"
  - Active order card: order number, date, item thumbnails, status stepper (Confirmed > Shipped > Out for Delivery > Delivered), "Track" button, "Cancel" button (if not shipped)                                              
  - Past order card: order number, date, items, total, "Reorder" button, "Rate" button, delivery status                                                                                                                        
  - Empty state for each tab                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  9. ORDER DETAIL SCREEN:                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Order number, placed date                               
  - Status stepper with timestamps                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - Item list with images, names, quantities, prices
  - Delivery address                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Payment method used                                     
  - Price breakdown                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - "Need Help?" button, "Return/Replace" button (for delivered orders)
10. ACCOUNT/PROFILE SCREEN (Tab):
  - Profile header: avatar, name, email, "Edit Profile" button                                                                                                                                                                 
  - Menu list with icons:                                   
    - My Orders                                                                                                                                                                                                                
    - My Wishlist
    - My Addresses                                                                                                                                                                                                             
    - Payment Methods                                                                                                                                                                                                          
    - Coupons & Offers
    - Notifications Settings                                                                                                                                                                                                   
    - Help & Support                                        
    - About
    - Logout (red)
  - Each item tappable with right arrow                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  11. LOGIN SCREEN:                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - App logo at top                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - "Welcome back" text                                     

  - Email/Phone input                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Password input with show/hide toggle
  - "Forgot Password?" link                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - "Login" button (primary, full width)                    
  - "Or continue with" divider                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - Social login: Google button
  - "New here? Create Account" link                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                            
  12. REGISTER SCREEN:                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - "Create Account" title                                  
  - Full name input
- Email input                                             
  - Phone number input
  - Password input with strength indicator
  - Confirm password input
  - Terms & conditions checkbox                                                                                                                                                                                                
  - "Create Account" button
  - "Already have an account? Login" link                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                            
  13. SEARCH SCREEN:
  - Auto-focus search input with back arrow
  - Recent searches list with clock icon and clear all                                                                                                                                                                         
  - Trending searches tags/chips                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Search results as you type (debounced)                                                                                                                                                                                     
  - Search result items: image, title, price, rating                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  14. ADDRESSES SCREEN:                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - List of saved addresses with name, phone, full address                                                                                                                                                                     
  - Default address badge                                   
  - "Edit" and "Delete" buttons per address                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - "Add New Address" button
  - Address form: name, phone, pincode, city (auto-fill), state (auto-fill), address line 1, address line 2, type (Home/Work/Other)                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  15. WISHLIST SCREEN:
  - Product grid similar to product listing                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - "Add to Cart" button on each card                       
  - "Remove" option on each card                                                                                                                                                                                               
  - Empty state with "Start Shopping" button
STATE MANAGEMENT:                                         
  - Redux store with slices: auth, cart, orders, products, wishlist, addresses, ui                                                                                                                                             
  - Cart: items array with product, quantity, variant                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Auth: user info, token, login status                                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Orders: active and past orders arrays                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Wishlist: product IDs array                                                                                                                                                                                                
  - Addresses: saved addresses with default flag                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                            
  DESIGN:                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Primary color: #2874F0 (Flipkart blue) or #FF9900 (Amazon orange)
  - Clean white background                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  - Card-based layouts with subtle shadows
  - Consistent 16px padding                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Product cards with rounded corners (12px)                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Star ratings in amber/gold (#FFC107)
  - Discount badges in green (#388E3C)                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - Price: current price bold black, MRP grey strikethrough                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Smooth transitions between screens                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - Professional typography hierarchy

Preferences:
Light theme, clean design
